why_best: This subtle, continuous presence keeps high-priority metrics feeling active and trustworthy during idle monitoring without pulling visual focus away from surrounding alerts.
why_bad: A sudden pop or hard entrance transition would break the calm analytical state required for dashboard observation by falsely signaling an immediate critical status change.
trap: A common mistake is allowing the movement to abruptly snap or hitch at the cycle seam, exposing the technical repetition to the user.
